summary_rationale: Eli Lilly and Company exhibits exceptional structural compounding characteristics driven by its dual-incretin (GIP/GLP-1) franchise Mounjaro and Zepbound, which reached $36.5 billion combined in FY2025 (56.0% of $65,179M total revenue) and $16,075M in Q3 2026 (65.9% of $24,397M Q3 revenue; 65.2% of $67,170M 9M 2026 revenue) alongside oral small-molecule GLP-1 Foundayo ($184M Q3 2026) and Phase 3 triple agonist retatrutide. Audited FY2025 operating margin expanded to 40.35% ($26,302M) with 83.04% gross margin and $16,813M CFO ($8,972M FCF), while 9M 2026 CFO more than doubled YoY to $27,420M ($18,983M 9M FCF after $8,437M PPE CapEx). Key operational risks updated through Q3 2026 include rising tirzepatide concentration (65.9%), double-digit realized net price erosion (-15% YoY consolidated and -29% ex-U.S. from China NRDL in Q3 2026), IRA Medicare price-setting selections for Jardiance (2026) and Trulicity/Verzenio (effective 2028, 15.4% of FY2025 revenue), Chugai tiered royalties on Foundayo in Cost of Sales, $18.24B in 9M 2026 M&A/IPR&D cash outlays ($4.18B Q3 IPR&D), $24.17B in accrued sales rebates, and $49.50B in gross debt.
